solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Disproof in due course turning round objection

indicators.note: round says the reversed word wraps itself around the objection
turning signals that the word for 'in due course' is read backwards

parts.note: something done in due course is done later
a 'but' is an objection, as in 'no ifs or buts'

explanation.surface: Someone eventually turns an objection around into a proof that the other side was wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebuttal is a counter-argument that shows a claim to be false, which is what a disproof does.

clue.text: Playground and dinner room, not hard to bring to mind

parts.note: rec, short for recreation ground, is a British word for a public playground

indicators.note: not says the letter for hard is left out

parts.note: a hall is a dining hall in a college or school
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: School memories of the playground and dining hall come back easily.
explanation.definitionFit: To recall something is to remember it, to call it back to mind.

clue.text: Stop eating all types of fig

indicators.note: eating means taking in, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: to ban something is to stop it
any covers every kind, as in 'any sort will do'

explanation.surface: A dieter is told to stop eating every kind of fig.
explanation.definitionFit: The banyan is an Indian fig tree whose aerial roots grow down into new trunks.

clue.text: Suppressing that hurt, couple make up, if they're lucky

indicators.note: suppressing means holding down inside, so the cry is held within the couple

parts.note: a couple is two
ouch is what you say when something hurts

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word for make is read from the bottom

parts.note: to do something is to make it, as in 'do a cake'

explanation.surface: Swallowing the hurt, a quarrelling couple get back together with luck.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' means read from the bottom; the definition is the hopeful phrase people add when wishing for luck.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is said, often while tapping wood, to ward off bad luck, so it means with luck.

clue.text: Model mobilisation against slavery movement

indicators.note: to model is to shape or form, so these letters are reshaped into a new word

explanation.surface: A model campaign mobilising people against slavery.
explanation.definitionFit: Abolitionism was the campaign, notably in Britain and the US, to end the slave trade and slavery.

clue.text: Cavalryman, one acting as surgeon?

definitions.meaning: a mounted soldier armed with a lance
someone who lances a boil or abscess, cutting it open as a surgeon would

explanation.surface: A mounted soldier on the battlefield doubles up as the field doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: A cavalry soldier carrying a lance is so called; anyone who lances a boil does a little surgery, hence the question mark.

clue.text: A trap pinches area on the other hand

indicators.note: pinches means grips, so the trap holds the area letter inside it

parts.note: a gin is a snare or trap for game

explanation.surface: A trap catches a region, though the opposite might be true.
explanation.definitionFit: Again can introduce a contrasting point, meaning besides or by contrast, as in 'then again'.

clue.text: Dealer held new car after ordering

indicators.note: after ordering means once these letters have been put in a new order

explanation.surface: A dealer kept a brand-new car back once it had been ordered.
explanation.definitionFit: A chandler is a dealer in supplies, originally candles, now often ship's provisions.

clue.text: Consider carefully, hearing of space in boat

indicators.note: hearing of means the phrase is taken as it sounds when spoken

parts.note: room in an eight; an eight is a rowing boat with eight oarsmen

explanation.surface: A rower thinks hard on hearing there is room in the boat.
explanation.walkthrough: An eight is a racing rowing boat, so space in one is 'room in eight'.
explanation.definitionFit: To ruminate is to think deeply and at length, like a cow chewing the cud.

clue.text: Panellist following trick: his?

indicators.note: following places the panellist's word after the word for trick

parts.note: to con is to trick or swindle
a juror sits on a jury, a panel of citizens

explanation.surface: A panel member coming after a trick asks whose trick it was.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the bare 'his?': read with the clue before it, it asks whose trick this is, and the answer is the person who performs tricks.
explanation.definitionFit: A magician is the man whose trick it is, so 'his' trick points to the performer of illusions.

clue.text: I regret returning a mobster's first greeting

indicators.note: returning means the exclamation of regret is read backwards

parts.note: alas is an exclamation of regret

indicators.note: first takes only the opening letter of the word mobster's

explanation.surface: Someone sorry to see a gangster come back at the start of their meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A salaam is a low bow with the hand to the forehead, a respectful gesture of welcome in Muslim cultures.

clue.text: Beer may be safe

definitions.meaning: beer drawn straight from the cask rather than a bottle comes from the barrel
clear of danger or difficulty, past the worst

explanation.surface: Cask ale might turn out to be a safe bet.
explanation.definitionFit: Beer served from the cask is said to come this way, and anyone past danger has got clear of trouble.

clue.text: Reluctant to punch hole in strip of wood

indicators.note: punch suggests making a hole through the strip, so one piece goes into another
in places the hole within the strip of wood

parts.note: a lath is a thin narrow strip of wood
O is a hole, from the letter's round shape

explanation.surface: A carpenter is unwilling to drill a hole through a thin batten.
explanation.definitionFit: Being loath to do something means being unwilling or disinclined, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Ancient creature's droppings covered by one lecturer

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', linking the definition to the wordplay

indicators.note: covered by puts the droppings between the pieces for one and lecturer

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a don is a university lecturer, especially at Oxford or Cambridge
guano is the droppings of seabirds or bats

explanation.surface: A dinosaur's dung is examined by a lone academic.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's in 'creature's' is read as 'is', not a possessive.
explanation.definitionFit: The iguanodon was a large plant-eating dinosaur of the Cretaceous period, so very much an ancient animal.

clue.text: Spotted pieces undergoing chain reaction

parts.note: dominoes are spotted playing pieces; a row of them toppling one after another is the image behind a cascade of consequences

explanation.surface: Spotted game tiles fall over one after another in a line.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally the clue describes a toppling row of dominoes; the phrase for such a toppling names any cascade of linked events.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes one event setting off a series of similar ones, named after a row of toppling tiles.

clue.text: Capacity audience gives good hand

definitions.meaning: a theatre with every seat taken
in poker, three cards of one rank and two of another, a strong holding

explanation.surface: A sold-out crowd gives a performer a warm round of applause.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatres call a sold-out show this, and poker players call three of a kind with a pair by the same name.

clue.text: Toyed with splendid diamonds, holding up plate

indicators.note: holding means containing, so the reversed plate sits inside the word for splendid

parts.note: fine means splendid or excellent

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the plate's letters read from the bottom

parts.note: a reg is a car registration plate in British slang
D is the card abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: Someone fiddled with fine diamonds while holding up a dinner plate.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'reg' is British slang for a car's number plate, read upwards here because this is a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To finger something is to handle it idly or touch it with the fingers, much as one plays with it.

clue.text: Asking to change wine container

indicators.note: change tells us to alter the order of the letters before it

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a different bottle of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A wineskin made from a goat's hide was the traditional vessel for carrying wine.

clue.text: Excessively disobediently scuttling boat

indicators.note: to scuttle a vessel is to sink it deliberately, so the boat is removed

parts.note: acting insubordinately means defying authority, behaving disobediently
sub is short for submarine, a boat

explanation.surface: A crew rebels far too much and sinks their own vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Inordinate means beyond reasonable limits, so doing something inordinately is doing it to excess.

clue.text: One rule I would have lifted for festival

indicators.note: lifted in a down clue means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a law is a rule
I'd is the contraction of I would

explanation.surface: Someone would lift a single regulation for a holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Diwali is the Hindu festival of lights, held in autumn.

clue.text: Like a bone from very large duck?

parts.note: OS stands for outsize, a clothing size
a teal is a small freshwater duck

explanation.surface: A wishbone from an enormous duck.
explanation.definitionFit: Osteal is an adjective meaning bony, relating to or resembling bone, from Greek osteon.

clue.text: Try tiny portion, admitting it hurts not to be used

parts.note: to have a go is to try

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the cry of pain goes inside the portion

parts.note: a taste is a small sample of food
ow is the cry of someone in pain

explanation.surface: Someone sampling a morsel complains it hurts.
explanation.definitionFit: Something left to spoil without being used is wasted, the sense of the phrase here.

clue.text: What pilot earns proceeds from bet, leaving pub

indicators.note: leaving means the pub's word goes out of the bigger word

parts.note: winnings are the money gained from a successful bet
an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A pilot collects their gains from a wager on the way out of the bar.
explanation.definitionFit: Qualified pilots are awarded a badge shaped like a bird's spread pinions, so they earn these.

clue.text: They are expecting one to open what is not his?

indicators.note: to open means to go into, so the letter for one sits within the other word

parts.note: hers is the possessive belonging to her rather than him
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Expectant parents eye something that isn't his to open.
explanation.walkthrough: 'They are expecting' suggests pregnancy; here it means people expecting an inheritance.
explanation.definitionFit: People named in a will are waiting to inherit property, so they are expecting a legacy.

clue.text: Artillery piece shooting from side to side

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the British army's gunnery regiment
the king is a chess piece

explanation.surface: A field gun sprays fire across an enemy line.
explanation.definitionFit: Raking fire sweeps along a target from end to end, as a gun traversing the line would.

clue.text: Leave a key in flat, half inside self-contained unit

indicators.note: inside places the pick from flat within the word for self-contained unit

parts.note: a module is a self-contained unit, of a course or a spacecraft

indicators.note: half takes the second two of the four letters of the word flat

explanation.surface: Someone moving out drops a key in a flat while half the unit is still inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leave a key' is musical: changing from one key to another, not walking off and leaving a door key behind.
explanation.definitionFit: In music, to modulate is to shift from one key to another within a piece.

clue.text: Day to depose a not entirely horrible ruler

indicators.note: deposing removes someone from power, so the A is taken out
not entirely means the word for horrible loses its last letter

parts.note: nasty means horrible or unpleasant

explanation.surface: A rather unpleasant ruler is deposed in a single day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to depose a' removes A from DAY, leaving DY; 'not entirely' cuts NASTY to NAST.
explanation.definitionFit: A dynast is a hereditary ruler, a member of a ruling family.

clue.text: Move slowly by high ground for battle

parts.note: to edge is to move gradually or cautiously
a hill is an area of high ground

explanation.surface: Troops creep up towards a ridge before the fighting starts.
explanation.definitionFit: Edgehill, in Warwickshire, was the first pitched battle of the English Civil War in 1642.
